note: In the original most measurements are given in parentheses in the text (mm); they are reproduced here with the units marked. The ‘tubercles’ densely covering the wing surface are rendered as warts.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Type locality Laksman Beach, Campbell Bay, Great Nicobar Island, India; also recorded from Rajendra Nagar, 35 km from Campbell Bay. Distribution: Andaman and Nicobar Islands, India.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head and body dorsum chestnut brown; antennae, labrum, legs and sternites paler. Head and pronotum sparsely hairy, the abdomen more densely so. Body length with wings 6.0—7.0 mm, without wings 4.0—4.3 mm. Head capsule almost circular, its length including the eyes almost equal to the width, length to the mandibular base 0.88—0.95 mm, width including the eyes 0.84—0.92 mm; epicranial suture indistinct; sides slightly incurved behind the eyes at eye level; posterior margin rounded. Eyes medium-sized, oval, less than half their long diameter from the lower margin of the head; greatest diameter 0.26 mm. Ocelli small, oval, length 0.07—0.08 mm, width 0.05—0.07 mm, slightly separated from the eyes. Antennae 11-segmented; segment 1 longest, cylindrical; segment 2 shorter than segment 1, about as long as segments 3 and 4; from segment 5 onwards gradually larger and pear-shaped; terminal segment oval, shorter than the penultimate. Clypeus almost trapezoidal; anteclypeus translucent, band-like, hairless; postclypeus with a faint boundary, concave. Labrum broadly ligulate, with several hairs on the body and the anterior margin; length 0.23—0.26 mm, width 0.26—0.30 mm. Mandibles of the typical tree-termite type. Pronotum almost as wide as the head; length 0.53—0.56 mm, width 0.82—0.86 mm; anterior margin deeply incurved, without a median notch; sides rounded towards the rear; posterior margin slightly curved or almost straight. Legs short, thick, hairy; tibial spur formula 3:3:3; tarsi 4-segmented. Wings dark brown, densely covered with warts. Forewing: subcosta short, meeting the costa near the wing scale; radius meeting the costa at about 1/6 of the wing length; radial sector and media reaching the wing tip, unbranched; cubitus with 11—12 branches towards the posterior margin; the rest of the venation as in the genus. Hindwing venation as in the forewing, except that the media arises from the proximal part of the radial sector outside the wing scale and the cubitus has 12—13 branches. Abdomen elongate, sparsely hairy; cerci 2-segmented; male with single-segmented styli.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule red-brown, paler behind; antennae, labrum and body pale yellowish brown; mandibles black. Head and body sparsely hairy. Body length 5.0—6.5 mm. Head capsule almost rectangular, length to the mandibular base 1.58—1.60 mm, width 1.03—1.05 mm; frons sloping forwards at about 45°, smooth and slightly incurved; sides almost straight, posterior margin rounded; Y-shaped suture present; frontal basal projection weak. Eyes oval, length 0.14—0.19 mm, close to the antennae, at a distance less than their long diameter. Ocelli absent. Antennae 10—12-segmented; segment 1 long, cylindrical; segment 2 about half of segment 1; segment 3 small and slender, smaller than the remaining segments. Anteclypeus thin, band-like, hairless; postclypeus hairy, its boundary with the frons indistinct. Labrum almost square, length 0.20—0.23 mm, width 0.25—0.28 mm, anterior margin rounded. Mandibles stout, length 0.61—0.69 mm, less than half the head length; left mandible with 3 marginal teeth, teeth 1 and 2 close together in the distal third, tooth 3 small and pointed in the proximal third, with a long incurved margin between it and tooth 2; right mandible with 2 distinct marginal teeth, tooth 1 median, tooth 2 slightly smaller and below it. Postmentum club-shaped, widest in the anterior third, the waist behind the midpoint between the widest point and the posterior margin; length 0.95—1.11 mm, greatest width 0.30—0.37 mm, waist width 0.19—0.23 mm. Pronotum flat, almost as wide as the head, length 0.53—0.61 mm, width 0.95—1.03 mm; anterior margin broad and slightly incurved, with a shallow median notch; posterior margin slightly incurved in the middle. Legs short, thick, hairy; tibial spur formula 3:3:3; tarsi 4-segmented. Abdomen elongate, hairy; cerci 2-segmented; styli single-segmented.
